InstCombineLoadStoreAlloca.cpp.notes: Audited all alloca, load, store, memory helper and store-merging branches through EOF. Distinct successful transformations are separated by semantic branch; query/use-graph predicates are helpers, wrapper calls are delegations, and the shared load-construction utility is inventoried as a helper rather than a duplicate rewrite. The no-op PointerReplacer early return is explicitly excluded. Load/store/alloca effects and pointer/alias/CFG analysis remain exact Puddle blockers.
